dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins beginning from the mid-body and accelerating toward a sharp posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical convex lateral margins with no significant bulges or indentations visible at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity luminance across the entire visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single small, dark circular point is visible on the anterior-most portion of the head; several faint, low-contrast linear markings are visible on the posterior-mid dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple shallow, fine linear epidermal scratches (rake-like) are visible on the mid and lower dorsal surface, exhibiting low contrast against the white baseline.
